context_requirements: Expression of dopamine receptors (DRD2/DRD3) or other targets such as HTR2A, HRH1, ADRA1A
Intact downstream signaling through AKT/STAT3/NF-kB for antiproliferative and apoptotic effects
Proliferative drive that can be inhibited (e.g., hormone receptor-positive or other oncogenic signaling)
TP53 wild-type or functional for robust apoptotic and cell-cycle arrest responses
falsifiers: No change in any of the proximal immediate-early genes (FOS, EGR1, JUN) at 6 h in any cell line
No reduction in proliferation markers (e.g., CCNA2, CCNB1, MKI67) at 24 h in any cell line
No induction of apoptosis or cell-cycle arrest markers (e.g., CDKN1A, PMAIP1) at 24 h
Strong and consistent upregulation of proliferation genes across all lines at 24 h
Lack of any transcriptional response (all genes unchanged) in all nine cell lines at both time points

evidence.supports: Thioridazine, a dopamine receptor antagonist, inhibits tumor growth and induces apoptosis in breast cancer models, with effects on AKT/STAT3/NF-kB signaling.
D2 dopamine receptor blockade induces immediate-early genes (c-fos, zif268) in striatal neurons, demonstrating transcriptional response to DR antagonists.

changes: Removed EGR1 from proximal_down because it is already listed in proximal_up and the cited evidence supports induction, not repression, of immediate-early genes by DR blockade.
Removed TSC22D3 from proximal_down because it is listed in late_up and glucocorticoid-responsive genes are typically induced, not repressed, by this mechanism.
Removed TSC22D3 from late_up to avoid duplication with proximal_down; kept it only in late_up as an induced gene.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (CCND1, MYC, FOSL1, ATF1, CREB1, STAT3, NFATC3, NFATC4, RELB, NFKB2, PPP1R13B) from proximal_down because they are not immediate proximal targets of dopamine receptor antagonism and belong to generic downstream effects.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (CDKN1A, GADD45A, SQSTM1, TRIB3, DDIT4, SESN1, BNIP3, BNIP3L, PMAIP1, BAX) from late_up because they are generic stress/apoptosis/proliferation markers rather than specific proximal targets.

Removed generic proliferation genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, BUB1B, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A, PCNA, MCM3, MYBL2, UBE2C) from late_down because they are generic proliferation markers, not specific to dopamine receptor antagonism.
Removed PMID 19783049 and PMID 19896709 because their abstracts concern fish reproduction and behavior, not transcriptional profiling in the nine human cell lines.
Removed PMID 40227606 because its abstract concerns morphine and taurine synthesis in TNBC, not dopamine receptor antagonism.
Kept PMID 26095429 and PMID 10363818 as their abstracts support the stated claims about DR antagonist effects on signaling and immediate-early gene induction.
